# F₃-index of knots

Computed with all tree diagrams with n <= 8: a knot that is not listed has F₃-index > 8 (or is the unknot, index 1).
Knots up to mirror image, KnotInfo names. n = number of internal vertices of each ternary tree + 1. The representative is a ternary tree diagram of F₃ realizing the knot (leaf addresses, 0 = left, 1 = middle, 2 = right).
